mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation_schedule WHERE 1=1 ) AS totalConsultations, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM consultation_schedule WHERE 1=1 ) AS totalStudents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_report WHERE report_status = 'SUBMITTED' ) AS completedReports, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.counselor_id) FROM consultation_schedule cs JOIN staff_profile sp ON cs.counselor_id = sp.id WHERE cs.create_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(cs.create_time) >= #{q.startDate} AND DATE(cs.create_time) <= #{q.endDate} ) AS activeCounselors
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM consultation_schedule WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(submit_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM case_report WHERE report_status = 'SUBMITTED' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sub.first_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT student_id, MIN(create_time) AS first_time FROM consultation_schedule GROUP BY student_id ) sub WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(sub.first_time) >= #{q.startDate} AND DATE(sub.first_time) <= #{q.endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sub.first_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT sp.college AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM consultation_schedule cs LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON cs.student_id = sp.id WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(cs.create_time) >= #{q.startDate} AND DATE(cs.create_time) <= #{q.endDate} GROUP BY sp.college ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT pt.type_name AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM case_report cr LEFT JOIN problem_type pt ON cr.problem_type_id = pt.id WHERE cr.report_status = 'SUBMITTED' GROUP BY pt.type_name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT sa.counselorId, sa.counselorName, sa.consultationCount, sa.studentCount, COALESCE(ra.reportCount, 0) AS reportCount FROM ( SELECT cs.counselor_id AS counselorId, su.real_name AS counselorName, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.id) AS consultationCount, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.student_id) AS studentCount FROM consultation_schedule cs LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON cs.counselor_id = su.id WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(cs.create_time) >= #{q.startDate} AND DATE(cs.create_time) <= #{q.endDate} GROUP BY cs.counselor_id, su.real_name ) sa LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cr.counselor_id AS counselorId, COUNT(*) AS reportCount FROM case_report cr WHERE cr.report_status = 'SUBMITTED' AND DATE(cr.submit_time) >= #{q.startDate} AND DATE(cr.submit_time) <= #{q.endDate} GROUP BY cr.counselor_id ) ra ON sa.counselorId = ra.counselorId ORDER BY sa.consultationCount DESC, sa.counselorId ASC
